root_cause.text: The mailbox-test driver's cleanup code unconditionally frees both the TX and RX channels without checking if they point to the same mbox_chan object, causing a double-free when the RX channel is aliased to the TX channel.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the condition `tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel` before calling `mbox_free_channel(tdev->rx_channel)` in both the probe error path and the remove function. The commit message explicitly states: "The RX channel can be aliased to the TX channel if it has a different MMIO. This special case needs to be handled when freeing the channels otherwise a double-free occurs."

intent_record.intent_summary: Add a check to avoid double-freeing the mbox channel when both TX and RX channels are the same.
intent_record.what: Changed condition for freeing rx_channel from 'if (tdev->rx_channel)' to 'if (tdev->rx_channel && tdev->rx_channel != tdev->tx_channel)'.
intent_record.how: Prevents double-free of the same mbox channel object when both tx and rx channels point to the same channel in the error path of mbox_test_probe.
